rationale_evidence.statement: Critiques each of the rejected theorem's four conditions individually: reachability is a world/model assumption suitable as an experimental precondition but does not establish that KnowledgeOS can discover the path; DAG-ness/acyclicity should not become a KnowledgeOS invariant since real causal systems can contain feedback loops (e.g. configuration->traffic->load->autoscaling->configuration), at most a constraint on a specific synthetic test graph; full-context visibility as stated (some other node is admissible) is too weak since it doesn't guarantee a genuinely relevant node can be discovered, and the real experimental target should be whether a relevant dimension outside the initial focus can be discovered; and the terminal condition should use the already-frozen Determine contract (supported AND competitors excluded) rather than a graph-terminal IsRoot+OutDegree=0 condition, since reaching a root-cause node is evidence relevant to determination, not determination itself.
